card.name: Adjectives after 'the' before nouns like regimen
card.fires_on: An adjective ending in -ic or -al (therapeutic, scientific, technical, spiritual, commercial, technology) that sits right after 'the', 'his' or 'to the' and is followed by a noun such as regimen, studies or progress.

modes.label: Therapeutic before regimen
modes.description: The word therapeutic or the ending of diuretic comes before regimen or dosage in drug-label directions.
modes.example: Early consideration should be given to adding anti-inflammatory agents, e.g., corticosteroids, to the<< therapeutic>> regimen.

modes.label: Field adjectives in general prose
modes.description: Scientific, technical, spiritual, commercial or technology follows a determiner and names a field or activity.
modes.example: Increase Lapham continued to pursue with enthusiasm his<< scientific>> studies and investigations

card.writes: It nudges toward word endings like -ics and scene, which fits field-of-study words, but the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on descriptive words like therapeutic or scientific that come just before a noun naming a field or plan.
